Service-Notes:
- Seasonal porch decorating starts at $350+.
- Celebration setups, including home and hotel-room decor, start at $300+.
- Grazing tables and styled setups start at $250+ for styling only.
- Party game rentals (giant yard games, a movie screen and a card table, pickup and return in Memphis) are $40 per game per day; bundles from $85. Renting for a business? We can deliver to your business for $20.
- Food is not included by default for grazing tables; food sourcing may be available for an additional fee.
- Takedown for seasonal porch decorating and event decor: Takedown starts at $75, quoted with your setup. Party game rentals have no takedown: you return them at Mt. Moriah Station.

Booking-Notes:
- Quotes are custom based on porch size, setup type, scope, location, date, materials, setup needs, hotel or venue access, guest count, and optional take-down.
- Availability is not guaranteed until a request is confirmed.

Audience:
Clients in the Memphis metro area looking for porch decorating, hotel decor, party decor, birthday setups, romantic room decorations, grazing table setups, or polished celebration setup support.

- FAQ, every service: https://porchandparty901.com/faq/ (booking and payment, porch decor with the Price my porch calculator (Stoop, Classic, Grand and Showstopper packages for fall and Christmas, 10% off Christmas when both are booked), party and room decor, grazing tables with the size estimator and food as a separate rough estimate, party game rentals; $75 travel fee outside the eight listed cities)

## Focused pages (inside the four services)
- Hotel room setups in Memphis: https://porchandparty901.com/services/hotel-room-decor-memphis (part of party planning and decor, https://porchandparty901.com/services/celebration-setups). A hotel room setup in Memphis is a room Porch & Party styles before your person walks into it: rose petals and LED candles, balloons by the headboard, a bouquet on the pillows and styled touches, for an anniversary, a proposal or a birthday. Setups start at $300.
- Giant lawn game rentals in Memphis: https://porchandparty901.com/rentals/giant-lawn-games-memphis (part of party game rentals, https://porchandparty901.com/rentals/). Giant lawn game rentals in Memphis are oversized yard games you collect, play and return: Giant Connect Four, Cornhole Set, Giant Uno and Giant Color Stack. Each game is $40 a day or $60 for the whole weekend, picked up and returned at Mt. Moriah Station with your photo ID.
- Anniversary hotel room setup in Memphis: https://porchandparty901.com/services/anniversary-hotel-room-setup-memphis (part of hotel room setups, https://porchandparty901.com/services/hotel-room-decor-memphis). An anniversary hotel room setup is a hotel room Porch & Party decorates for your anniversary before the two of you check in: a rose-petal heart on the bed, LED candles, balloons and a "Happy Anniversary" sign. In Memphis, setups start at $300, and we are usually there between 3 and 6 PM.

The easiest version is to book the room and have Porch & Party decorate it while you are out.

## Party game rentals
Porch & Party rents giant yard games, an inflatable movie screen and a card table for backyard parties, birthdays, reunions, church and school events, indoors or outdoors. Page: https://porchandparty901.com/rentals/

Prices (every game, flat): $40 per game per day; $60 per game for a weekend (the entire weekend: Friday, Saturday and Sunday). One day: pick up the day before the event or that morning, return the day after or 2 days after. Weekend: pick up Thursday or Friday, return Monday or Tuesday. Same price whichever days. No minimum order.
- Giant Connect Four (4 ft tall, indoor or outdoor)
- Cornhole set, 2 regulation boards + 8 bags
- Giant Uno, oversized Uno cards, same rules, table or lawn, ages 7+
- Grab the Mic, tabletop singing party game (flip a word card, first to grab the foam mic and sing a lyric with the word scores), 2-10 players, ages 8+, indoor
- Giant Color Stack, 2 ft color-sorting stacking puzzle, 5 poles, rings in 4 colors, ages 6+ (one set of two)
- Inflatable Movie Screen: $50 a day, $75 a weekend. An inflatable outdoor movie screen with its blower, stakes and an extension cord. Need a projector? We can include one, just ask when you book. Bring your own speaker; it needs a plug within 50 ft.
- Card Table with Cup Holders: $15 a day, $25 a weekend. A folding card table with a green felt top, four cup holders and chip trays. No chairs.

Bundles: Pick 3: any 3 games, $110; Pick 5: any 5 games, $175; Whole Yard: all games (available now: 6), $195; Movie Night: the inflatable movie screen + any 2 games, $110; Game Night: the card table + any 2 games, $85; The Whole Party: all games (available now: 6), the movie screen and the card table, $235 a day or $350 a weekend.
No delivery: pickup and return at Mt. Moriah Station, Memphis Police Department, 2602 Mt. Moriah Rd, Memphis, TN 38115, a safe exchange zone. Pickup time is set by text or call to 901-355-1518 after payment. One day: pick up the day before your event or that morning, and bring everything back the day after or 2 days after. The entire weekend (Friday, Saturday and Sunday): pick up Thursday or Friday, and bring everything back Monday or Tuesday.
Holding the date: $50 damage deposit + 50% of the rental fee by Zelle or Cash App from the invoice; the rest is paid at pickup by Zelle or Cash App (never cash). $50 damage deposit refunded at return. Government photo ID is checked at hand-off against the invoice name.
We ask every renter for a government photo ID. It keeps our games and your party safe. The request form takes about three minutes, with no account or sign-in.
Terms: full refund if cancelled 48 hours before pickup; rain or storms reschedule free within 30 days; renter 18+.
Book: https://porchandparty901.com/contact or call/text 901-355-1518.
